title: What If a Train Ran in a Vacuum Tube? Hyperloop Tried

scenes.text: What if trains ran at 600 miles an hour inside a vacuum tube? Hyperloop promised exactly that.
Elon Musk floated the idea in 2012, aiming for more than 1,000 kilometers an hour.
On November 8, 2020, two people rode a pod in the Nevada desert for the first time.
It reached about 107 miles an hour, or 172 kilometers an hour, in roughly 15 seconds.
That was a fraction of the promised speed.
In 2023 Virgin Hyperloop dropped passengers and cut 111 jobs, and by year's end it had shut down.

description:
What if trains ran in a vacuum tube at airplane speeds?
Virgin Hyperloop carried its first passengers in 2020 at about 172 km/h, then shut down in 2023.
